library.broken_repair_confirm.title: Attempt repair?
library.broken_repair_confirm.message: '{name}' will be backed up, then its files re-packaged into a .ts4script and installed. This is best-effort only — it can fail silently if the original extraction was incomplete, in which case the mod still won't work even after this.
library.broken_delete_confirm.title: Delete this folder?
library.broken_delete_confirm.message: '{name}' will be backed up, then permanently removed from Mods/.
library.script_mods_warning: ⚠ Script Mods Allowed is off in the game's options — .ts4script mods won't load.
library.conflicts.toggle: ⚠ {count} unmanaged mod folder(s) found — click to review
library.conflicts.broken_mod_empty_line: '{name}' is an empty folder under Mods/ — likely a harmless unused placeholder.
library.conflicts.broken_mod_unextracted: '{name}' contains an unextracted archive ({zips}) — the game won't load a .zip, extract it first.
library.conflicts.broken_mod_unpacked_sc: '{name}' contains loose script files but no .ts4script ({files}) — it may have been extracted instead of installed as-is.
library.conflicts.broken_mod_unrecognize: '{name}' contains {files} — nothing the game would load. Worth checking manually before deciding what to do with it.
library.conflicts.broken_mod_fix_confirm: '{name}' is an empty folder — it will be backed up, then deleted. Nothing else is affected.
'{name}' will be backed up, then its archive ({zips}) will be extracted and installed as a new managed mod. The original folder is removed afterward.
library.detail.author: by {value}
library.detail.conflict_duplicate_packag: These mods share {count} identical .package file(s) — likely the same mod installed twice, or one bundling the other's files. Pick which one to keep below.
library.detail.conflict_exact_duplicate_: These mods share 100% of their files ({count} file(s), byte-for-byte) — this is the same mod under two different entries. Pick which one to keep below.
library.detail.conflict_ts4script_collis: These mods all ship a script file named '{filename}' — only one may actually load. Pick which one to keep below.
library.detail.conflict_folder_duplicati: These mods have the exact same name except for a trailing (1)/(2)/... — almost certainly the same mod downloaded or installed more than once. Pick which one to keep below.
library.delete_confirm.title: Delete mod?
library.delete_confirm.message: This removes '{name}' from the library permanently.
catalog.title: Catalog
catalog.subtitle: Browse and install mods from CurseForge.
catalog.assisted_mode_notice: Catalog browsing requires a valid CurseForge API key. In Assisted Mode, browse mods in your web browser and install them via the download watcher instead.
updates.title: Updates
updates.subtitle: Check for and apply mod updates.
updates.direct_notice: Checking compares each installed mod's file against the latest release CurseForge currently serves.
updates.assisted_notice: Automatic update detection isn't available in Assisted Mode. Open a mod's CurseForge page to check manually — downloading a new version will be picked up automatically by the download watcher.
updates.empty_assisted: No installed mods have a known CurseForge link yet.
updates.update_all_message: This will update {count} mods, backing up each one's current version first:
cache.suggest_message: Mod changes can leave stale cache entries behind, which can themselves cause crashes. Clear now?
crash.title: Crash Mode
crash.subtitle: Diagnose the last crash and clean up stale cache.
crash.no_exception_file: No lastException.txt found — nothing to analyze.
crash.no_suspects: No suspect found directly in the trace.
crash.bisection_round: Testing: disabled {mods}. Relaunch the game, then report what happened.
crash.bisection_inconclusive: Bisection finished without isolating a single mod.
crash.confirm_faulty: Confirm this mod caused the crash
settings.title: Settings
settings.backup_retention_notice: Set via BACKUP_RETENTION_COUNT in .env — a replaced mod's oldest backups beyond this count are purged automatically.
settings.mods_watcher_notice: Set via MODS_WATCHER_ENABLED in .env — catches mods added/removed outside SimsLink while it's running.
settings.logging_notice: Set via LOG_LEVEL in .env (DEBUG/INFO/WARNING/ERROR/CRITICAL) — controls both the log file above and console output.
settings.full_scan_notice: Recomputes every file hash — can take a while on large libraries.
settings.profiles_notice: A profile saves which mods are active right now, under a name — activating it later enables exactly that set again and disables everything else.
settings.blacklist_notice: Local and manual only — flags installed mods whose name or id matches a pattern you've entered here. Never blocks anything by itself.
downloads.detected_message: New file detected: {filename}. Install this mod?
downloads.detected_replace_message: New file detected: {filename}. This looks like an update for '{mod_name}'. Replace it?
